eps.ov: Hiyori is entering her first year of high school. Unfortunately, her dreams of a high school debut are quickly shattered when she realizes her soul has fallen out of her body and Yato has possessed her. Canon.

eps.t: The Promise of That Spring Day
eps.ov: Yato, Yukine and Hiyori decide to have a picnic at Suzuha's cherry tree. Canon.
